page.layout: One printed page, text only. Main text in one column, with a marginal note at the left margin ("Libro 2. cap. 3.") beside the paragraph about the generation of mixed bodies. Lower down, a catchword-like fragment "I. Par-" at the right below the last line.

main_text.l: ut corpus aliquod mixtum ex illis prodeat: veluti
caro, os, nervus, &c. prorsus quemadmodum aquæ
nimium calidæ contemperantur frigida affusa, do-
nec apta fiat, ut quis in ea lavet. Quo quidem pacto

l.i: neque elementa, neque eorundem extrema contraria,

main_text.l: sunt simpliciter ipsius corporis mixti materia: sed
ipsorum elementorum commune temperamentum,
ad corporis mixti naturam ita accedens, ut certa
species proveniat, a quo & nomen rei inditur. Hoc
inquam commune elementorum temperamentum
corporis mixti materia existit.
Unde fit, quod corporum mixtorum
adeo variæ generentur
species?
Ex eo quod elementa non contemperentur sem
per cadè inter se proportione. Itaque, si ab igne domi
netur calor, prodit aliqua species, in qua uis ignea
eminet. Si ite dominetur in cotemperatione elemen
torum frigiditas, prodit aliqua species, in qua domi
natur aqua: veluti glacies, &c. Sic & caro genera-
tur ex terra & aqua, unde siccitas & frigiditas in
ea deprehenditur.
Vtrum ad generatione corporum com-
positorum necessario concurrat
aliquid de singulis ele-
mentis?
Maximè. Probatur duabus rationibus.

page.notes: Printed page number "184" is set with a long-s style "1" of the old face; read as 184. The marginal note at the left reads "Libro 2." with "cap. 3." below it, placed beside the paragraph. Words "sem per" and "cadè" are as printed (sem per cadè is likely "semper cadè", read as printed). Text "Ex eo quod" and "Ex eo quòd" are uncertain at the line join; read as printed. The word "Itaq;" is rendered "Itaque" with the abbreviated q; retained as printed in the source. Fragment "I. Par-" at the foot is a catchword of the next page. Several words in the italic passage "Quo quidem pacto..." are set in italics as printed. Some words in the text are slightly blurred and should be checked against the scan.
